name: Naigai Tec Corporation
court: inline advance court, main session 2026-08-03 (agent budget exhausted); generator was the mechanical EDINET shelf + FX overlay, so the generator-never-grades-itself invariant holds; no score reached 6 so no red team required
fx_context: USD/JPY 163.85 (Jul-23) -> 157.19 (Aug-2), +4.2% yen; IBKR IDEALPRO daily mid, tape-verified
verdict: PASS 3/10 at spot — the entry closed before we got here, and the growth is margin-dilutive
mode_b_first: Independent read: a factory-automation distributor with JPY 5.9B of net cash against a JPY 11.1B cap looks like a classic net-cash bargain, but FY3/27 guidance is the tell — revenue +24.5% against recurring profit +5.1%. A distributor passing 24% more volume for 5% more profit is buying share with margin, and the cheap EV/EBIT of 3.7x sits on earnings that do not scale. Add +47.5% year-to-date and the discovery_state is DISCOVERING, not undiscovered — the tape has already found it.
fx_note: the FX overlay is AMBIGUOUS here and I will not credit it: the business description is 'imports, EXPORTS and distributes'. Import relief on inventory is offset by an unquantified export book, and the direction cannot be resolved without segment disclosure. This is precisely the case where the cohort logic must not be applied mechanically.

mode_a_verification.liquidity: ~$1M/day on a $71M cap — second-deepest in the batch, volume above its 6-month average
mode_a_verification.no_reform_lever: absent from the JPX value-up list; Gonda family ~18%

entry_plan.rationale: ~0.70x book and the pre-run level; 17-23% below spot. Courted to SET the re-entry, not to buy
entry_plan.sizing: 0.3% if the band trades, contingent on the margin question resolving

kill_triggers: recurring-profit growth stays below half of revenue growth for two more quarters — confirms structural margin dilution rather than mix timing
net cash falls below 40% of market cap (the downside cushion is the thesis)
adjudication_spec: FY3/27 H1: does the revenue/profit gap close? If revenue +24.5% delivers profit growth under 10%, the distribution model is confirmed margin-dilutive and the name leaves the shelf.
